profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Renterra
profile.summary: Results-driven software engineer with a strong track record of designing and delivering scalable, performant and user-focused applications. Proficient in C#(.NET), web frameworks and other toolings to create full-stack solutions leveraging different architectures best suited for client’s needs. Dedicated to writing high-quality, maintainable software solution aligned with modern industry standards and best practices. Committed to continuous learning and professional growth to deliver innovative and efficient software solutions.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Architect and deliver api service for facilitating user credentials for payment processing product.
● Aid in building payment processing platform utilizing multiple vendors ensuring usability and persistence. 
● Developed and deployed packages to be used by external developers.
● Prepared and completed SOC 1 report.
● Building user dashboard with multi tenancy to view and manage their api key and merchants.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Delivered homegrown software reducing dependency on external vendors and reducing cost of operation significantly while expediting case processing speed substantially. Cutting down usual outreach time from weeks to a day or two.
● Designed and implemented robust API services using C# (.NET) delivering highly performant document processing service for legal document processing following DDD and Clean Architecture. 
● Developed and deployed scalable microservices, ensuring fault isolation in case of failure.
● Created CI/CD pipelines using Docker and Azure services for rapid deployment environment with reduced build and deploy time.
● Designed API services for effective communication between frontend and backend system, enhancing performance and reliability.
● Built and maintained monorepo for front-end, ensuring consistent and performant UI experience for clients and streamlined developer experience for rapid development cycle.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · C# · Full-Stack Development · TypeScript · Microservices · React.js · Microsoft Azure · DevOps · Software Design

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
● Developed and enhanced client websites using a diverse tech stack, including Next.js for the frontend and headless CMS/Node.js for the backend enhancing clients’ web presence.
● Collaborated with clients to understand their needs and integrated their existing marketing tools or CMS, such as HubSpot or Salesforce, into the newly built application streamlining client’s marketing process.
● Ensured web accessibility standards for all users to provide an inclusive user experience.
● Followed Agile methodology to ensure efficient project management and timely delivery of high-quality websites.
● Built utility components in frontend and backend frameworks to reducing ticket processing time and enhance efficiency.
● Applied modular design providing rapid development cycle for quick delivery with quality components.
Demonstrated strong time management skills by consistently meeting project deadlines.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Full-Stack Development · Agile Methodologies · Analytical Skills · WordPress · PHP · JavaScript · Next.js · React.js · Node.js · HTML · SASS · Digital Marketing

positions.title: Web Developer / Broker
positions.description:
- Maintain company website by working with an external marketing company and working on a WordPress template.
- Market Professional Liability Insurance for business professionals in various fields.
- Provide multiple coverages starting from Employment Practices Liability to Directors and Officers, Error and Omission, and Fiduciary Liability as well as Cyber/Data Breach Liability.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Web Development · WordPress · Full-Stack Development · PHP · React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Insurance Specialist
positions.description:
- Issue out new policies to members of USAA
- Adjust policy per member's request to meet state requirement
- Issue policy most suited for members

positions.title: Property Manager
positions.description:
- Create ads and promotion of the properties online for future tenants
- Create lease and filing according to company guideline
- Facilitate communication among my residents for disputes
- Oversee all my tenants' data and update with new information

positions.title: Digital Marketing & Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Manage and develop current and new websites by utilizing WordPress CMS.

- Brand development and management through maintaining good SEO practice and creative design.

- Collaborate with other department members to generate new content.
